Name: Zombie Outbreak
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod aaa rar'r raaa a rararr raaargh ar rghar aarrr aarghaar a araar...

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Daily chance for a random villager to become infected.
[*]Chance of zombie villagers and zombie players to infect other villagers and players on proximity.
[*]Zombie villagers turn green.
[*]Zombie players turn green and get debuffs.
[*]Fully-articulated, grammatically-correct zombie language for both players and villagers.
[*]Zombie scowling.
[*]Craftable zombie cure thanks to Harvey and Demetrius.
[*]Craftable 5G towers to increase infection rates (just kidding, this is a joke).
[/list]

[b][size=4]Config[/size][/b]

  "[b]GreenAmount[/b]": 0.8, - how green to make zombies (0 - 1)
  "[b]DailyZombificationChance[/b]": 0.1, - chance each day that some villager will randomly become a zombie (0 - 1)
  "[b]InfectionDistance[/b]": 128, - how close in pixels a villager or player has to get to a zombie to become infected (positive integer)
  "[b]InfectionChancePerSecond[/b]": 0.05 - chance each second for a villager in range to become infected by a zombie (0 - 1)


Cured players and zombies cannot be infected again that same day.

Stardew zombies don't eat brains. They are more of the shops-at-Ikea variety of zombies than the eats-brains variety (that's a reference to [url=https://www.chrismoore.com/books/the-stupidest-angel/]The Stupidest Angel[/url], my favourite zombie story).


[size=4][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
